To make §2hydroxylamine§r, react hydrogen and nitric oxide with a platinum catalyst bed.

To make §5clohexanone§r, two feedstocks are relevant: benzene and phenol.

To produce §5cyclohexanone§r from §6phenol§r, you can use a supported §7palladium§r catalyst to directly hydrogenate §6phenol§r to §5cyclohexanone§r or you may use a supported nickel catalyst to first hydrogenate to §dcyclohexanol§r and then dehydrogenate §dcyclohexanol§r to §5cyclohexanone§r over supported §bnickel§r.

To produce cyclohexanone from cyclohexane (which itself is a product of benzene hydrogenation), liquid-phase oxidation using a §ccobalt acetate§r catalyst. This produces a mixture of §dcyclohexanol§r and §5cyclohexanone§r known as §eketone-alcohol oil§r, which needs to be washed with soda ash solution to remove impurities along with byproduct water. The remaining mixture can then be distilled into its components. The §eketone-alcohol oil§r is also used to produce adipic acid, which will be relevant in EV.
